scientific_target.question: Do genuine simultaneously recorded vestibular spike pairs reduce held-repeat angular-velocity error beyond the admissible training-only stimulus/phase prior, in each recorded animal and motion condition?
scientific_target.known_answer: Measured angular head velocity at every valid native target sample of a complete held stimulus repeat. Reconstructing this measured trajectory is a neural decoding target; reproducing the paper’s encoding/correlation figures is not the answer.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Experimental motion signal in the versioned VO deposit; authentic units, sign, sample clock and repeat membership remain to be established from payloads.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete held stimulus repeat within an authenticated animal/session/recording group and motion condition.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Three macaques; repeat, recording group, neuron and pair dependencies remain nested and shared-neuron links are retained.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-recording held-repeat decoding under a frozen permitted history. Leave-animal-out calibrated transfer is a separate proposed condition. Repeated deterministic stimuli can be decoded from phase alone.
exclusions: No claim of unseen-animal transfer from the current held-repeat scorer.
No general population precision or mechanistic proof from three animals.

inputs: Exact spike timestamps for each genuine observed pair or fixed training-selected spike-count bins, native query duration/timebase, and input-derived quality/core masks.
Training repeats and only explicitly allowed calibration; retain complete naturalistic and eight sinusoidal-frequency conditions with real availability accounting.
forbidden_inputs: Held velocity values, original waveform identity or absolute repeat phase when not in the declared information condition.
Tuning/filter/normalization fitted on held repeats; LIF simulations substituted for biological spikes.
observation_contract.case_identity: The v2 scorer requires case id, group_id, condition, repeat_id and exact integer sample_ticks; groups retain animal_id, session_id, recording_id, neuron_ids and pair_id. The prepared-inventory projection supplies operator-keyed opaque participant case/group/channel IDs and a separate protected crosswalk. Authentic source values remain unresolved; structural declarations or admission hashes do not prove biological identity or simultaneity.
observation_contract.split: The prepared-inventory projection validates declared whole-presentation train/query separation and requires training repeats for every held group-condition. The reference bridge accepts a separately pinned prior with unique declared training-only source records. Neither authenticates the original split or proves actual prior training. Freeze source-derived whole-repeat partitions and temporal buffers covering all model lags before authentic preparation; secondary animal transfer requires a separate calibrated protocol.
observation_contract.coverage: Census shape is 3 animals, 49 neurons, 35 pair relationships and nine required conditions. Every animal-condition-stratum cell is represented, including unavailable cells with reasons. Groups are actual recordings, not necessarily 35 groups; single neurons are separate diagnostics. The authentic full repeat roster remains unresolved.

primary.name: Animal-by-condition vector of prior MSE minus candidate MSE
primary.aggregation: Mean squared error on each fixed valid repeat core; equal repeat means within each genuine simultaneous recording group; equal group means within each animal-condition cell. Report every cell without a cross-animal primary scalar.
primary.rationale: Requires signal-derived reconstruction to improve on the legitimate repeat-phase alternative while preserving the actual biological and condition coverage.

secondary: Raw candidate and prior MSE per repeat/group/cell.
R², Pearson correlation, signed bias, scale/intercept and sign agreement; constant targets keep MSE and have explicitly undefined variance-based statistics.
Sample-duration-weighted MSE and all singleton strata are named secondary outputs.

comparators.name: Training-only motion/phase prior
comparators.inputs: Only phase/stimulus information legitimately available in the selected access condition and training-repeat velocity.
comparators.procedure: Externally choose and freeze the strongest admissible prior using training/development only; scorer consumes one prior array and does not verify selection competence.

comparators.name: Wiener/ridge neural decoder
comparators.inputs: Same permitted pair spike bins, timing/history and calibration as candidate.
comparators.procedure: Proposed competent linear decoder; choose lags and ridge penalty on training-only grouped validation. No authentic fit is delivered.

comparators.name: Static firing-rate readout
comparators.inputs: Same observed pair, reduced to fixed rate features.
comparators.procedure: Proposed train-only rate/tuning baseline to distinguish temporal coding gain from overall spike count.

nuisance_controls: Whole-repeat reassignment and within-pair temporal shifts preserving autocorrelation; identical replayed waveforms can make reassignment powerless and must be reported.
Phase/stimulus-only and spike-count-only predictions on identical frozen support.
Authenticate simultaneity, animal/session/cell identity and units/sign; keep the figure-specific 41-neuron subset distinct from the full 49-neuron census.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all three animal estimates and recording/shared-neuron dependence. The scorer computes no population confidence interval or significance threshold; bins, pairs and repeats are not independent animals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Missing/extra/duplicate cases, shifted clocks, participant masks, nonfinite or incomplete predictions refuse the entire primary result. Predetermined unavailable cells remain explicit; never average successful cases only.
